events.title: Italy's Veneto wins the first UEFA Regions' Cup , beating Spain's Madrid 3–2, after extra time , in Abano Terme .
폴 스콜스 scores twice as England beat Scotland 2–0 at Hampden Park in the Euro 2000 qualifying playoff first leg.
England qualify for Euro 2000 despite a 1–0 second leg defeat by Scotland at Wembley. 아스널 announce plans to move to a new 60,000-seat stadium at Ashburton Grove near Highbury , their home since 1913.
Marc Overmars scores a hat-trick in 아스널's 5–1 home league win over 미들즈브러.
맨체스터 유나이티드 wins the Intercontinental Cup in FC 도쿄 by defeating Brazil's 파우메이라스: 1–0. The only goal for the English club is scored by Roy Keane in the 35th minute.

맨체스터 유나이티드 are back on top of the Premier League as November draws to a close, with former leaders 리즈 유나이티드 now bracketed on points with 아스널 as their nearest rivals. Newly promoted 선덜랜드's excellent start to the season sees them still in fourth place, with a resurgent 리버풀 standing fifth. 셰필드 웬즈데이 and 왓퍼드 continue to prop up the rest of the Premier League, accompanied in the drop zone by a 더비 카운티 side who had spent the previous two seasons chasing a place in Europe. 맨체스터 시티 remain top of Division One, with 허더즈필드 타운 now second and in the hunt for top division for the first time in nearly 30 years. 찰턴 애슬레틱, 입스위치 타운, 반즐리 and 풀럼 occupy the playoff places.
